reserveReview.rationale: The newest daily report in the issuer's September 2026 Ankura archive is Ondo USDY LLC_ATCAttest_260923.pdf (end of day 9/23/2026; downloaded and hashed 2026-09-29). Ankura Trust Company, LLC, as Verification Agent under the Tokenized Credit and Security Agreement dated July 29, 2023, reviewed and confirmed the Market Values, CUSIPs, and Maturity Dates of the Permitted Assets through read-only access to the deposit, brokerage, operating, and exchange accounts. The report reconciles 15 US Treasury bill positions across StoneX/BNY Mellon and Marex ($2,081,813,286.65), a First Citizens Select MMA ($620,484.42), and StoneX brokerage cash ($10,080.25) to Permitted Assets of $2,082,443,851.32 against Token Principal Outstanding of $2,066,500,758.43 (coverage 1.007715). Stated per-instrument maturities run from 1 day (912797UH8, maturing 9/24/2026) to 344 days (912797WA1, maturing 9/2/2027); slice maturityDaysMax values are those stated figures, not converted averages. The report's footnote 1 states it reflects only USDY issued by Ondo USDY LLC and does not account for USDY issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited. The excluded share is measured exactly as the suspended live adapter measures it: canonical circulating USD (chain-supply generation ed34a648, capture 2026-09-29, $2,197,639,635.26) minus report-time LLC principal ($2,066,500,758.43) = 5.9673%, and is carried inside the composition as the explicit bounded-unknown high-risk slice at index 17 and flagged through knownUnknownExposurePct, so the review does not claim a fully verified composition while the BVI share lacks per-token attribution. Ondo's own OGM (BVI) daily verification-agent report of 2026-09-22 corroborates the excluded scope: 173,440,642.63 USDY tokens outstanding with market value $198,949,893.44, backed only by OGM's shared collateral pool (fiat, trading, custodian, and stablecoin accounts shared with tokenized securities and USDon), which is not attributable per-token; the BVI share therefore remains unclassified rather than being restated as Treasury exposure. Slice weights are market value / permitted assets scaled to the 94.0327% LLC-covered share.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Ankura-verified Ondo USDY LLC permitted-asset holdings at stated market values; excluded BVI scope measured from canonical circulating supply minus report-time LLC principal
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The 5.9673% issued outside the LLC report scope (Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited issuance, plus measurement timing) is carried as the bounded-unknown high-risk slice at index 17. Its backing is OGM's aggregate collateral pool (fiat, trading, custodian, and stablecoin accounts shared with tokenized securities and USDon), which the OGM daily verification-agent report attests only in aggregate; no per-token instrument census exists, so the share stays a known unknown rather than being restated as Treasury exposure.
